observations: Photo 0 shows a white PlayStation console standing upright on a black tufted surface, with a white DualSense controller in front of it.
Photo 1 shows the same console from a slightly different angle, with the same controller in front.
The console has a slim, vertical design with a PlayStation logo on the top left corner.
The controller is white with black accents and a touchpad in the center.
The background is a wooden slatted wall, and the console is placed on a black cushioned surface.
No visible damage or wear is apparent on the console or controller in the photos.
No power cord, cables, or accessories are visible in either photo.

claims.claim: Ps5 console fat uk used with 1 pad
claims.evidence: The console appears to be a PlayStation 5, but the 'fat' model is not visible in the photos. The 'UK used' claim cannot be verified remotely. The controller is a DualSense, which matches the description of '1 pad'.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Console may be non-functional or have internal damage
risks.proof: A video showing the console powering on, booting up, and running a game or menu.

risks.risk: Controller may be non-functional or have battery issues
risks.proof: A video showing the controller connecting to the console and responding to button presses.

risks.risk: Console may be a counterfeit or non-genuine unit
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the console's serial number and model label, or a video of the console's system settings screen showing the correct model.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (power cable, HDMI cable, etc.)
risks.proof: A photo showing all included accessories laid out next to the console.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and booting up.
Video of the controller connecting and functioning.
Close-up photo of the console's model and serial number label.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
